newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Schiphol Express wins KLM regional cargo contract.
newsitem.headline: Schiphol Express wins KLM regional cargo contract.

text.p: AMSTERDAM, June 27 Reuter)- KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV Cargo has awarded a road transport contract to Schiphol Express BV for trucking cargo between Amsterdam Schiphol Aiport and two regional airports.

Schiphol Express will now carry out trucking between the main Dutch airport and the airports of Twente in the east of the Netherlands and Maastricht Aachen Airport(MAA) in the south, a KLM Cargo spokesman said.
Previously the trucking was handled by Jan de Rijk BV.

Schiphol Express is already the ground handler for KLM Cargo at Twente and it was now take on KLM cargo handling at MAA from Maastricht Handling BV, the spokesman said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
